fullContentHtml:
Short Information : Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC) has recently published the official notification for the posts of Scientific Officer Biology on its official website. This recruitment has been issued for 25 posts. The online application process for MPPSC Scientific Officer Biology Recruitment 2026 has started from 21 April 2026, and candidates can apply till 20 May 2026. Candidates must check the complete details of MPPSC Scientific Officer Biology Recruitment 2026 given below.

Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC)

MPPSC Scientific Officer Biology Recruitment 2026

MPPSC Advt No. : 07/2026

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 21 April 2026
  • Last Date : 20 May 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 20 May 2026
  • Correction Date : 26 April 2026 to 22 May 2026
  • With Late Fee Phase I Last Date : 21 May 2026 to 27 May 2026
  • With Late Fee Phase II Last Date : 28 May 2026 to 28 October 2026
  • Exam Date : 22 November 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 12 November 2026
  •  Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 540/-
  • MP Reserve Category : Rs. 290/-
  • PH (Divyang) : Rs. 290/-
  • Late Fess Phase I : Rs. 3000/- + Portal Fee
  • Late Fess Phase II : Rs. 25000/- + Portal Fee
  • Portal Charges : Rs. 40/- (Included)
  • Correction Charges : Rs. 50/- (Extra)
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

MPPSC Scientific Officer Biology Notification 2026 : Age Limit

  • Age Limit As On 01 January 2027
  • Minimum Age : 21 Years
  • Maximum Age : 40 Years
  • Age Relaxation as per MPPSC Scientific Officer Biology Recruitment Rules.
  • Use Tool –

MPPSC Scientific Officer Biology 2026 : Vacancy Details

Total Posts : 25 Posts

Post Name Category  No. of Posts
Scientific Officer Biology General  07
EWS 02
OBC 07

MPPSC Scientific Officer Biology Recruitment 2026 : Educational Qualification

  • Postgraduate Degree in any of the following subjects with at least 2nd Division: Botany, Zoology (Animal Science), Biochemistry, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Forensic Biotechnology, Genetics, Molecular Biology, Biosciences, Life Science, Forensic Science from a recognized university.
  • For Graduation, both of the following conditions are mandatory:
  • (a) Botany, Zoology (Animal Science), Bioscience, Life Science, Biotechnology, Microbiology, Forensic Biology
  • (b) Chemistry, Biochemistry, Forensic Chemistry
  • All candidates must read the official information completely before applying.

MPPSC Scientific Officer Biology Online Form 2026 : How To Apply

  • Candidates can apply through link https://mppsc.mp.gov.in/ or provided below in link section or they can also apply through official site of the MPPSC before Last Date.
  • You Can Check other Notification Here –
  • For all the interested and eligible candidates who want to apply for MPPSC Scientific Officer Biology recruitment can read all the information related to the recruitment is given below and the link to apply is given in the Important Link section below.
  • Note – छात्रो से ये अनुरोध किया जाता है की वो अपना फॉर्म भरने से पहले Official Notification (Last Date, Age Limit, Qualification) को ध्यान से जरूर पढे उसके बाद ही अपना फॉर्म भरे ।

MPPSC Scientific Officer Biology Recruitment 2026 : Mode of Selection

  • Written Exam
  • Personal Interview
  • Document Verification
  • Medical Examination
